_comment: Every control-protocol and manager-protocol surface item with its consumers. Consumers: "viewer" (crates/fux/src/client), "cli" (crates/fux/src/main.rs subcommand or verbatim reply printing), "zor:<path under crates/zor/src>", or "none". A cli-only consumer is acceptable for a primitive, never for a workflow. Reviewed by tests/protocol_consumers.rs.

split.why: Creates a pane and starts its process; only the PTY owner can.

focus.why: Moves the retained focus that the viewer renders.

kill.why: Terminates a pane's process; only the process owner can.

resize.why: Changes the retained layout the server owns.

send-keys.why: Unsequenced write to the PTY, the CLI's debugging input; zor delivers input through the receipted input-* requests.

input-reserve.why: Reserves a sequenced input operation with a receipt.

input-submit.why: Writes the reserved operation's bytes to the PTY.

input-status.why: Reads the retained receipt of an input operation.

capture.why: Coherent snapshot of the retained grid.

list.why: Enumerates the server's workspaces, tabs and panes with their identity and counters.

info.why: Server identity and limits over the control socket; the CLI prints it for debugging, zor reads identity from the manager descriptor instead.

tab.why: Tab lifecycle inside a workspace the server owns.

workspace.why: Workspace lifecycle from a control connection; zor run releases its throwaway workspace with it.

events.why: Bounded replay of the event log after a cursor.

subscribe.why: Live sequenced event stream after a cursor.

final.why: Carries the retained final record inside the manager's final reply.

events.why: Replayed events and the cursor to continue from.

unit.why: Completion without a value (focus, resize, kill, send-keys, tab actions); the viewer clears its outstanding request on it.

tab.why: The tab a tab action created or selected.

workspace.why: The workspace a workspace action created, selected or killed.

capture.why: Text capture with its sequence counters; zor reads input_sequence from a one-byte capture.

info.why: Reply of the control-socket info request, printed verbatim by the CLI.

workspace.changed.why: Layout or focus changed; zor counts it toward cursor continuity.

pane.opened.why: Launch correlation reads the pane and command of the event.

pane.closed.why: Exit evidence on the event stream.

pane.output.why: Output arrived; zor re-captures on the next scan.

tab.opened.why: Tab lifecycle on the event stream.

tab.closed.why: Tab lifecycle on the event stream.

command.why: Launch correlation matches the pane by its argv.

pid.why: Process identity zor probes and pins targets to.

cwd.why: Launch and worktree correlation match the pane by its directory.

title.why: Retained pane title in the listing; zor reads the title from the capture instead.

seq.why: Output sequence counter in the listing; zor reads revision instead.

revision.why: Grid revision zor uses to skip unchanged captures.

input_sequence.why: Input counter zor correlates receipts with.

geometry.why: Retained layout rectangle, printed for debugging.

modes.why: Retained terminal modes, printed for debugging.

exit_status.why: Exit evidence in the listing; zor reads it from the final record.

id.why: Tab identity, the argument of tab select-id, rename and close.

index.why: Tab position, the argument of tab select.

name.why: Retained tab name, printed for debugging.

focused.why: Retained tab focus, printed for debugging.

event_cursor.why: Stream and sequence zor subscribes and replays from.

focused.why: Retained workspace focus, printed for debugging.

viewers.why: Attached viewer count, printed for debugging.

pid.why: fux workspace new confirms the server it started won startup.

instance_nonce.why: fux workspace new pins the descriptor it reads to the server's identity.

version.why: Server version, printed by fux info / fux workspace info.

runtime_dir.why: Runtime directory, printed by fux info / fux workspace info.

workspace.why: Answering workspace when asked over a control socket, printed by fux info.

limits.why: Request-sizing bounds, printed by fux info / fux workspace info.

scrollback_lines.why: Bound for capture scrollback, printed for debugging.

frame_bytes.why: Bound for one control frame, printed for debugging.

capture_bytes.why: Bound for capture max_bytes, printed for debugging; zor sizes requests with its own constant.

key_bytes.why: Bound for input payloads, printed for debugging.

text.why: Screen text; zor prints and correlates the final record's text.

revision.why: Grid revision of a text capture; zor reads it from the cells reply.

rows.why: Text capture geometry; zor reads it from the cells reply.

columns.why: Text capture geometry; zor reads it from the cells reply.

scrollback_offset.why: Scrollback rows included in a text capture, printed for debugging.

title.why: Pane title of a text capture; zor reads it from the cells reply.

progress.why: OSC 9;4 progress of a text capture; zor reads it from the cells reply.

unchanged.why: if_revision short-circuit of a text capture; zor uses the cells reply.

truncated.why: zor refuses a truncated final screen.

seq.why: Output sequence counter, printed for debugging.

input_sequence.why: Input counter the observation is correlated with.

revision.why: Grid revision the observation is pinned to.

rows.why: Geometry the rules expand rows against.

columns.why: Geometry the rules expand rows against.

unchanged.why: if_revision short-circuit the observer's cache honours.

truncated.why: A truncated capture is never classified.

row.why: Row index the rules check for order.

cells.why: Run-length cells the rules expand to text.

pane.why: Receipt is checked against the target pane.

command.why: Launch correlation matches the record by argv.

cwd.why: Launch correlation matches the record by directory.

exit_status.why: The exit status only the process owner observed.

input_sequence.why: Input counter at exit, correlated with the last receipt.

create.why: Create-only workspace for a run that must not borrow an existing one.

final.why: Retained exit evidence that outlives the workspace socket.

resolve.why: Attach-or-create for fux workspace new and fux attach.

info.why: Server identity for fux workspace info and startup confirmation.

attach.why: Descriptor of a resolved or created workspace.
